{{Quote|Keep your head up, look at your opponent, and check your balance. The point should be at eye level — or slightly lower — like so...|[[Kyle Katarn]]'s fencing [[instructor/Legends|instructor]] at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>}}
'''Fencing''' was the art of training and sparring with [[Sword/Legends|swords]], including [[lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]; as such, fencing was comparable to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|Lightsaber combat]].<ref name="JK" /> Those who practiced it were known as '''fencers'''.

==History==
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A [[Lightsaber Fencing Tournament]] was held at the [[Jedi academy]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] towards the end of [[Roan Novachez]]'s second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of attendance there. Roan was pitted against his friend, [[Pasha]], though at the time the two were not getting along. During the tournament, the bullies [[Cronah]] and [[Cyrus (Jedi Academy)|Cyrus]] shone a light in Pasha's eyes and Roan stopped the fight in order to allow Pasha to recover. This mended their friendship and Pasha went on to win the tournament, demonstrating excellent lightsaber technique.
{{Noncanonend}}

[[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Ketrian Altronel]] met and subsequently fell in love while learning to fence.

[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was considered to be a master in the art of fencing with a lightsaber.

During the [[Imperial Era]], fencing was a discipline taught to the [[cadet/Legends|cadets]] in the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. [[Kyle Katarn]] remembered their instructor who demanded unquestining obedience from them, but was moderate enough to not take advantage of it. [[5 ABY/Legends|Years later]] Katarn found this training useful when he first used [[Qu Rahn's lightsaber]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
